title: Analytics
description: Daily follower totals, growth windows, and connection health for the channels in this workspace.
emptyNoChannelsDescription: Connect a Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok account on the Social Channels page to start collecting daily metrics.
emptyNoKeyDescription: Daily metrics accumulate from the day a channel is connected. Pick a wider window, or wait for new data to roll in.
tableEmpty: No daily metrics yet. The first snapshot lands within 24 hours of connecting a provider; the chart and table will populate automatically.
noWindowedData: No data in the {count}-day window yet. The first snapshot lands within 24 hours of connecting; check back tomorrow.
chartAria: {title} for {profileName}, plotting {metric}. Numeric values are in the table below.
chartDescriptionOne: A line chart showing {metric} over {count} day for {profileName}. Numeric values are in the adjacent table.
chartDescriptionMany: A line chart showing {metric} over {count} days for {profileName}. Numeric values are in the adjacent table.
chartNotEnoughData: Not enough data to chart yet
chartNumericValues: Numeric values for {profileName} are in the table below the chart.
comparisonDescription: Compare the same metric across the selected channels on one shared scale.
noComparableMetrics: There is no metric available across every selected channel. Select channels from the same platform or choose a compatible combination.
providerErrorDetail: Some daily metrics are unavailable because the provider returned {code}. The next sync tick will retry.
healthReauthDetail: The provider rejected the stored token. Reconnect to restore the daily sync.
healthSyncErrorDetail: The next sync tick will retry. If this persists, check the connection.
healthStaleDetail: The next sync tick will recover. No action required.
